elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) requires Kubient, at Customer's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance following termination or expiration. The Customer-controlled request mechanism does not deprive Customer of the assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) expressly provides assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination or expiration.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) expressly applies Kubient's then-current rates.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires Kubient to return to Customer all Customer data in its possession or control following termination or expiration.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) expressly requires return within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) expressly specifies a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete the returned Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires Kubient thereafter to delete such data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of the Customer Data thereafter.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires Kubient to certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) requires Kubient to provide reasonable transition assistance at Customer's request following termination or expiration.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated period of up to six months encompasses and exceeds the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires return of all Customer data in Kubient's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format, satisfying the data-export requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) expressly requires the data return within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration.

result.reason: The redline implements every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It preserves the existing reciprocal Confidential Information return-or-destruction obligation and adds only related exit-assistance, data-return, deletion, and certification terms. Drafting is substantively clear, though quality is reduced by inconsistent capitalization of the likely defined term “Customer Data” and list-formatting issues, including a period after subsection (iv) followed by lowercase subsection openings.
